item: Stoplist batch 6 (R131, language group 5): 379 chrome lines, function words and number debris in ja ko zh; fragments and names left out
key_paths: configs/stopwords_extra/PROVENANCE.md tests/test_analytics_extract.py tests/test_stopword_file_scripts.py scripts/stopword_batch.py configs/stopwords_extra/ja.yml configs/stopwords_extra/ko.yml configs/stopwords_extra/zh.yml configs/stopwords_extra/_multilingual.yml
summary: Fifth T5 batch under the maintainer's go (R131): ja 215, ko 26, zh 138 words from the triage's accepted candidates (page chrome read as one keyword, function words, weekday and date words, number and clock debris, stock reporting phrases) against the same merged log as the earlier groups (sha256 6467504ab8ab); ja.yml and zh.yml are new files and eight entries with Latin letters inside Japanese or Chinese text go to _multilingual.yml, so the script guard and the tool's script map learn the two scripts. These languages are the exception to the other groups because their keywords are whole sentences, so the batch takes the chrome and leaves out the fragments the triage coded fr (ko 232, ja 60, zh 25: a Korean noun cut at its particle is a real word), every sentence that names a person, an organisation or an event, the mojibake and the English words. Of the 1,333 candidates the tool refused 548, the thread left out 404 by hand and the independent read removed two more (zh 徐欣瑩競辦提供, a credit naming a candidate and her campaign office, and ja ホーム, the platform and the home game once Japanese is split). The 379 words are declared in test_analytics_extract. Hidden at query time, no re-index. Left: the single-reader languages and the layout PR.
